initial_expectation_corrections.detail: Independent initial split x156 included the leading spending digit in the population cell for Taipei/Kaohsiung. Raw source glyphs show population ends x151.66 and spending begins x152.59; corrected split to x152, independently checked source image. Four initial token differences were reviewer boundaries, not producer errors.
Public total647 is physical column3 (type total), not column2; source image confirms. Initial local filtered-grid index corrected.
Public row is data row2 of original full table, after National Central Library row1. Filtered local row1 corrected to original row2.

visual_review_scope.visually_checked: All relevant table headers, column groups, original row labels and footnotes, plus targeted numbers including table16 Keelung population and joined Taipei/Kaohsiung population/spending boundaries.
visual_review_scope.not_claimed: Not a manual eye-reading transcription of all844 numeric values; all844 were independently checked against original PDF numeric glyphs.

scope_findings.finding: Each county table explicitly excludes National Taiwan Library and National Library of Public Information; 22 original county labels including Taoyuan County are retained.

preserved_source_anomalies.detail: Preserved original, although displayed holdings/population do not reproduce this ratio.

First subtotal printed after non-book row is arithmetically book-material subtotal (book+periodical+newspaper+other), not book+non-book combined; final total also includes non-book and electronic resource values. No change to source numbers.

limitations: This review does not validate the underlying libraries reporting accuracy or reconcile original inconsistencies.
Publication date/copyright-page agreement was not reaudited here; focus is source tables, data years, scope and all numeric cells.
Complete original authored PDFs remain private; only statistics and necessary provenance are reviewed for public packaging.
